response.justification: Highly experienced fullstack engineer with well over the required 6 years, including recent, directly relevant work in TypeScript/Node.js, React, MongoDB, AWS and Kubernetes at product companies in Berlin. Notably, his current role at re:cinq includes AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling, which maps precisely to the rare 'AI agent development' requirement. Strong testing/craftsmanship culture (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, authored test runner and assertion libraries) fits the code-quality and process-improvement responsibilities well. Main uncertainties are the absence of Nest.js and Vitest/Jest by name, thin recent Kotlin/Java exposure, and a resume that spreads across many niche technologies (notably DLang) rather than demonstrating depth in the exact primary stack. These are verifiable in a technical interview and do not outweigh the overall fit.
strengths: Deep TypeScript/Node.js + React experience with AWS, MongoDB, Docker/K8s
Direct AI-agent and MCP tooling experience — a rare, explicitly required skill
Strong testing and engineering-craft background (TDD, CI/CD, OSS test tooling, workshops)
concerns: No mention of Nest.js, Vitest, or Jest anywhere in the resume
Kotlin/Java exposure is dated (2016–2018) and secondary
Breadth across many niche stacks (DLang, Swift, PHP) may dilute primary-stack depth

key_factors.factor: Missing Nest.js and named testing frameworks
